title: VSV FOR EXHAUST BYPASS VALVE COMPONENTS FOR REMOVAL AND INSTALLATION
ocr_text:
EG–307
ENGINE – SFI SYSTEM (2JZ–GTE)

VSV FOR EXHAUST BYPASS VALVE
COMPONENTS FOR REMOVAL AND
INSTALLATION

Air Hose
Control Cable Clamp
VSV
VSV Connector

P11080

Continuity    Ohmmeter

P1137N

No Continuity    Ohmmeter

P11375

VSV INSPECTION
1.    REMOVE VSV
2.    INSPECT VSV
A.    Inspect VSV for open circuit
Using an ohmmeter, check that there is continuity between
the terminals.
Resistance:
     At 20°C (68°F) 22–26 Ω
If there is no continuity, replace the VSV.

B.    Inspect VSV for ground
Using an ohmmeter, check that there is no continuity be-
tween each terminal and the body.
If there is continuity, replace the VSV.
